categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: biotechnology health products and electronic products sales. The biotechnology segment focuses on nutritional health supplements, while the electronic segment mainly involves DRAM IC and 3C products. In 2023, electronic products accounted for approximately 60.91% of revenue, and biotech products made up 39.09%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops health supplements using patented active ingredients and advanced formulations such as phospholipid-type Omega-3 and microbubble calcium tablets. Production involves powder, liquid, and tablet forms manufactured by ISO-certified facilities. The company emphasizes clinical validation, high bioavailability, and innovative delivery technologies like microencapsulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include professional medical channels such as pharmacies, clinics, hospitals, and wellness centers, as well as digital sales channels like e-commerce, TV shopping, and influencer marketing. The company targets diverse consumer groups including infants, children, adults, and the elderly, focusing on health-conscious individuals seeking nutritional supplements and electronic product users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s sales are primarily domestic in Taiwan, accounting for 72% of revenue, with the remaining 28% from other Asian markets. It also has strategic plans to expand into the US and Southeast Asia through OEM/ODM partnerships. The company maintains a global outlook, targeting core health supplement markets in Asia, North America, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources high-quality raw materials globally from top suppliers, engages in product development and innovation, and distributes finished products through multiple sales channels. It also provides OEM/ODM services, indicating involvement in manufacturing and branding stages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the health supplement product portfolio with a focus on health aging, joint care, high-absorption Omega-3, and energy/stress management products. The company plans to increase R&D investment, develop innovative formulations, and leverage clinical research. It also aims to strengthen multi-channel marketing, brand collaborations, and digital sales capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of health supplements and electronic products. The company also earns income from OEM/ODM manufacturing services. Sales channels include wholesale, retail, e-commerce platforms, and partnerships with professional medical and wellness distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly fragmented and growing health supplement market, which has over 1500 brands in Taiwan alone. It positions itself as a professional and innovative player emphasizing product efficacy, clinical validation, and brand trust. Competitors include other biotech supplement manufacturers and electronic product distributors in Taiwan and Asia.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$99.16 million, a 155% increase from the previous year, driven mainly by electronic product sales growth. Despite revenue growth, the company recorded a net loss of NT$32.07 million due to increased marketing expenses and financial asset valuation losses. The company maintains stable financial health with a low debt ratio and plans to invest NT$6 million in R&D in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes scientifically validated, high-efficacy health supplements with transparent ingredient dosages and patented formulations. It differentiates through clinical research-backed products targeting aging, joint health, and energy management. The company also leverages professional endorsements, multi-channel distribution, and strategic IP collaborations to build brand credibility and consumer trust.
